en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town in a river valley. Ornate 19th‑century and early 20th‑century buildings with mansard roofs line both sides of a narrow river or canal. On the right side, a long colonnaded promenade is crowded with many people walking along the water. Steep wooded hills rise behind the town, topped with large grand hotels or villas. In the foreground at right, a gable of a building carries an advertisement in German mentioning "Wiener Krondorfer Sauerbrunn" and a Trinkhalle (drinking hall).
